title: Affordable Health Planning Programmes for Adult Singaporeans
what_it_is: Affordable Health Planning Programmes for Adult Singaporeans

sections.label: Health plans and Active Health
sections.summary: Over half of HSG enrollees have consulted doctors for a personal Health Plan, with Active Health Labs, Community Health Posts and HealthHub resources supporting healthier lifestyles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: More than half of HSG enrollees have consulted their chosen doctors to develop a personal Health Plan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, Sport Singapore’s Active Health Labs offer residents opportunities to have a guided fitness and health assessment, and recommendations on how to achieve fitness and health goals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Healthcare providers can prescribe Active Health's targeted programmes to residents who are medically at risk of lifestyle-related conditions such as Type 2 diabetes, obesity or hypertension.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Some Community Health Posts provided by healthcare clusters at accessible locations, such as Active Ageing Centres, also provide support for individuals to make diet and lifestyle changes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Resources, such as informative articles recommended programmes, are also available on HealthHub and Healthy 365, to support residents in embracing a healthier lifestyle.

sections.label: Partners and health information sources
sections.summary: The speaker says they work with various partners, and Healthy 365 and HealthHub are key information sources for citizens and residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That is why we work with various partners.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are the key sources of information which we want citizens and residents to refer to, like Healthy 365 and HealthHub.

sections.label: HPB as starting agency for partners
sections.summary: For partners wanting to work with them, the Health Promotion Board is suggested as the agency to start with.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If you are looking at it, though, from the perspective of partners who want to work with us, perhaps, I would suggest the Health Promotion Board (HPB) would be the one agency that maybe useful for you to start off with.

sections.label: Building those up
sections.summary: The speaker states that they are also building those up at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean
sentences.text: At the moment, we are also building those up.
